text:
Ian: customer reports embeddings API throwing dimension mismatch errors intermittently since 04:00 UTC. high latency spikes too. stack: eu-west-1, model: rw-embedding-1536-v1
Maya: can you paste the exact error they see?
Ian: here's the log from their side (sanitized):
```
Error: InvalidEmbeddingDimension: expected 1536 got 1024
request_id: rqd-9a2b
model: rw-embedding-1536-v1
region: eu-west-1
batch_size: 16
client: web-search-svc
```
Jordan: hmm 1024 dims implies the request may have been routed to a 1024-dim variant (us-east pool still hosting rw-embedding-1024?). could be cross-region spillover if eu capacity was exhausted.
Maya: do we have autoscaling events around 04:00 for eu-west?
ops-bot: [deploybot] autoscaler: eu-west-1-embeddings scaled up +2 nodes at 2024-11-15T03:58:41Z
Jordan: scaled up, but that doesn't rule out short cold starts causing fallback routing to us-east. also batching can amplify mismatch if a mix of model variants get aggregated.
Sam: can we get the customer's request headers + Host/Region header? also need their client library version.
Ian: they sent curl repro: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-embedding-1536-v1","input":["a","b","c"],"batch_size":16}'
```
Maya: no region override in headers. by default routing should pick eu-west based on account region, but if eu capacity is full, we route to nearest fallback which might be us-east with different model family.
Jordan: can you repro internally with burst that forces spillover? try sending a mix where some requests are pinned and some are not. watch the ``x-redwood-routing`` response header.
Sam: reproed locally: when eu pool saturates, control plane routes some requests to us-east; the model alias mapping was misconfigured so alias "rw-embedding-1536-v1" pointed to a 1024-dim variant in us-east (edge case during last rollback).
Ian: omg. so the alias mapping drifted during rollback?
Sam: yes — a canary rollback earlier this week replaced the us-east alias with a 1024 build and the mapping wasn't reconciled in the global alias table. if a request lands in us-east the model is 1024.
Maya: what's the remediation? rollback the alias or prevent cross-region routing?
Jordan: immediate mitigation: 1) pin routing for accounts affected to eu-west by setting account-routing override, 2) hotfix alias mapping to point to a compatible 1536 build in us-east, 3) run a global alias reconciliation job.
Rita: for the customer, can we offer a credit for failed calls? billing wants a short summary to authorize.
Ian: yes please — they lost > 300 embedding calls and reported feature regression.
Sam: patch pushed: alias table corrected at 04:18 UTC. also added a guard so alias with different output_dim can't be used as a fallback for that model name.
ops-bot: [auditor] alias-reconcile: started 2024-11-15T04:19:05Z; discrepancies found: 1; corrected: 1
Jordan: after the fix I ran a synthetic burst to force spillover — now routing refuses cross-region fallback when dims mismatch; instead returns 429 Backpressure if eu is full. that's safer.
Maya: customer-facing short repro and suggested client workaround?
Ian: asked customer to set header `X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1` to force eu routing while we stabilize. they confirmed it reduced errors but latency remained elevated for a few mins due to cold starts.
Sam: we also added a warm-up path: when adding capacity we pre-warm embeddings binaries to avoid long tail cold starts. deploy went out at 04:40 UTC.
Rita: billing: approved one-time credit for the failed calls, send me the request id range.
Ian: provided them the ids. also logged internal incident.
Jordan: next steps: 
- run daily alias reconciliation for 7 days
- emit alert when routing fallback picks a model with different output_dim
- update docs to call out `X-Redwood-Region` header and pinning in SDK for embeddings
- add end-to-end test for alias rollback cases
Maya: I'll update support KB with repro steps and the temporary mitigation (region header + smaller batch_size)
Sam: added a unit test to runtime to validate dimension compatibility during batching. will monitor metrics for eu-west error rate for 24h.
Ian: customer replied: "thanks, errors gone after header pin. will watch perf" :thumbsup:
Maya: great. closing thread once SLOs stable.
Sam: leaving monitoring alerts for engineering.
ops-bot: [pager] incident resolved (routing alias mismatch) 2024-11-15T05:02:12Z
Ian: thanks everyone. action items assigned, will follow up in postmortem.
